doc.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

title: Bailey's birth date found through marriage records
summary: Bailey never knew his parents; he found his age (69, born January 28) through his marriage record at city hall.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Birth? Mm-hmm. Birth? You mean when he was born, you mean? Yeah, I mean. Well, I couldn't tell you that. You don't know? Because my mom and daddy died when I was a baby. And I never knew my mom and daddy. It was two old ladies. I knew my mom and daddy before I was born. And by me traveling, we were going to play music, you know, going out of town. But I still got my buss, I got upstairs there. By me traveling, playing music, going out of town. I rode to Washington, went down to the new city hall, new courthouse on Royal Street. Paid four dollars and rode all the way to Washington, come back and the city records went up, come back again. So I had to go to the new city hall back here. Mm-hmm. So they found my marriage, the ticket when I got married. Wow. So now, so now I got the right dope. So now I'm, I'm age 69 now.
Oh, you never knew that and you know you just have turned 69.
Oh yeah, just, just made it. They found my records when I got married. What was your birthday? Uh, it was on January the 28th.
Mine's the 29th. Yeah. We're almost birthday pals.
I got my marriage thing up there. It's, it has the same as the birth certificate.
